				WHEN r.`ammonia_nitrogen` > 0 THEN r.`ammonia_nitrogen`
				ELSE NULL

				WHEN r.`total_phosphorus` > 0 THEN r.`total_phosphorus`
				ELSE NULL

			, CASE 
				WHEN r.`chemical_oxygen_demand` > 0 THEN r.`chemical_oxygen_demand`

			, r.`data_date` AS `data_date`
		FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT *
			FROM `ods_iot_db`.`water_quality`
			WHERE device_id IS NOT NULL
				AND trim(device_id) <> ''
				AND event_time IS NOT NULL
		) r
	)

		WHEN s.device_status = 'online' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS BIGINT) AS `online_count`
	, CAST(SUM(CASE 
		WHEN s.device_status = 'offline' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS BIGINT) AS `offline_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
		WHEN s.device_status = 'fault' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS BIGINT) AS `fault_count`, CAST(AVG(s.battery_level) AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) AS `avg_battery_level`, CAST(MIN(s.battery_level) AS INT) AS `min_battery_level`, CAST(AVG(s.signal_strength) AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) AS `avg_signal_strength`
	, CAST(MIN(s.signal_strength) AS INT) AS `min_signal_strength`, CAST(AVG(CASE 
		WHEN s.device_status = 'online' THEN 1.0
		ELSE 0.0
	END) AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `online_rate`, CAST((CASE 
		WHEN AVG(CASE 
				WHEN s.device_status = 'online' THEN 1.0
				ELSE 0.0
			END) > 0.9
			AND AVG(s.battery_level) > 20
		THEN 'excellent'
		WHEN AVG(CASE 
				WHEN s.device_status = 'online' THEN 1.0
				ELSE 0.0
			END) > 0.8
			AND AVG(s.battery_level) > 10
		THEN 'good'
		WHEN AVG(CASE 
				WHEN s.device_status = 'online' THEN 1.0
				ELSE 0.0
			END) > 0.6
		THEN 'fair'
		ELSE 'poor'
	END) AS STRING) AS `device_health_score`, CAST((current_timestamp()) AS TIMESTAMP) AS `created_at`, CAST(s.`event_date` AS STRING) AS `event_date`
FROM (
	SELECT device_id, manufacturer, 'water_monitor' AS device_type, device_status, battery_level
		, signal_strength, event_date
	FROM `dwd_iot_db`.`water_quality`
	UNION ALL
	SELECT device_id, manufacturer, 'air_monitor' AS device_type, device_status, battery_level
		, signal_strength, event_date
	FROM `dwd_iot_db`.`air_quality`
	UNION ALL
	SELECT device_id, manufacturer, 'soil_monitor' AS device_type, device_status, battery_level
		, signal_strength, event_date

			, CAST(AVG(f.`air_avg_no2`) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_no2_air`, CAST(AVG(f.`air_avg_so2`) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_so2_air`, CAST(MAX(CASE f.health_risk_level

			END) AS BIGINT) AS `air_data_count`, CAST(AVG(f.`air_avg_pm25`) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_pm25`, CAST(AVG(f.`air_avg_pm10`) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_pm10`, CAST(AVG(f.`air_avg_temp`) AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_air_temp`, CAST(AVG(CASE 
				WHEN f.data_type = 'soil' THEN f.environment_quality_score
			END) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `soil_quality_score`
			, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.data_type = 'soil' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `soil_data_count`, CAST(AVG(f.`soil_avg_ph`) AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_soil_ph`, CAST(AVG(f.`soil_avg_moisture`) AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_soil_moisture`, CAST(AVG(f.`soil_avg_om`) AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_organic_matter`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.pollution_level = 'heavy' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `heavy_pollution_count`
			, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.pollution_level = 'moderate' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `moderate_pollution_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.pollution_level = 'light' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `light_pollution_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.pollution_level = 'clean' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `clean_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.health_risk_level = 'high' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `high_risk_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.health_risk_level = 'medium' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `medium_risk_count`
			, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN f.health_risk_level = 'low' THEN f.record_count
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `low_risk_count`
		FROM `dwt_iot_db`.`environment_theme_fact` f
		GROUP BY f.location_code, f.event_date, f.season
	), 
	weighted_daily AS (
		SELECT d.*, CAST(coalesce(water_quality_score, 0) * 0.4 + coalesce(air_quality_score, 0) * 0.4 + coalesce(soil_quality_score, 0) * 0.2 AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS overall_environment_score
		FROM daily d
	), 
	daily_result AS (
		SELECT CAST(s.`location_code` AS STRING) AS `location_code`, CAST(s.`event_date` AS DATE) AS `event_date`, CAST(s.`season` AS STRING) AS `season`, CAST(s.`data_points` AS BIGINT) AS `data_points`, CAST(s.`water_quality_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `water_quality_score`
			, CAST(s.`water_data_count` AS BIGINT) AS `water_data_count`, CAST(s.`avg_ph` AS DECIMAL(6, 3)) AS `avg_ph`, CAST(s.`avg_dissolved_oxygen` AS DECIMAL(6, 3)) AS `avg_dissolved_oxygen`, CAST(s.`avg_turbidity` AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_turbidity`, CAST(s.`air_quality_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `air_quality_score`
			, CAST(s.`air_data_count` AS BIGINT) AS `air_data_count`, CAST(s.`avg_pm25` AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_pm25`, CAST(s.`avg_pm10` AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS `avg_pm10`, CAST(s.`avg_air_temp` AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_air_temp`, CAST(s.`soil_quality_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `soil_quality_score`
			, CAST(s.`soil_data_count` AS BIGINT) AS `soil_data_count`, CAST(s.`avg_soil_ph` AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_soil_ph`, CAST(s.`avg_soil_moisture` AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_soil_moisture`, CAST(s.`avg_organic_matter` AS DECIMAL(5, 3)) AS `avg_organic_matter`, CAST(s.`heavy_pollution_count` AS BIGINT) AS `heavy_pollution_count`
			, CAST(s.`moderate_pollution_count` AS BIGINT) AS `moderate_pollution_count`, CAST(s.`light_pollution_count` AS BIGINT) AS `light_pollution_count`, CAST(s.`clean_count` AS BIGINT) AS `clean_count`, CAST(s.`high_risk_count` AS BIGINT) AS `high_risk_count`, CAST(s.`medium_risk_count` AS BIGINT) AS `medium_risk_count`
			, CAST(s.`low_risk_count` AS BIGINT) AS `low_risk_count`, CAST(s.`overall_environment_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `overall_environment_score`, CAST((CASE 
				WHEN overall_environment_score >= 0.8 THEN '优秀'
				WHEN overall_environment_score >= 0.6 THEN '良好'
				WHEN overall_environment_score >= 0.4 THEN '一般'
				ELSE '较差'
			END) AS STRING) AS `environment_grade`, CAST((CASE 
				WHEN data_points > 0 THEN (heavy_pollution_count * 4.0 + moderate_pollution_count * 3.0 + light_pollution_count * 2.0 + clean_count) / data_points
				ELSE NULL
			END) AS DECIMAL(6, 3)) AS `pollution_index`, CAST((current_timestamp()) AS TIMESTAMP) AS `created_at`
		FROM weighted_daily s
	), 
	monthly AS (
		SELECT CAST((year(s.event_date)) AS INT) AS `year`, CAST((month(s.event_date)) AS INT) AS `month`, CAST((concat(year(s.event_date), '-', lpad(CAST(month(s.event_date) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-01')) AS DATE) AS `month_date`, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.location_code) AS BIGINT) AS `monitoring_locations`, CAST(SUM(s.data_points) AS BIGINT) AS `total_data_points`
			, CAST(AVG(s.`water_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_water_quality`, CAST(MIN(s.`water_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_water_quality`, CAST(MAX(s.`water_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_water_quality`, CAST(AVG(s.`air_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_air_quality`, CAST(MIN(s.`air_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_air_quality`
			, CAST(MAX(s.`air_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_air_quality`, CAST(AVG(s.`soil_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_soil_quality`, CAST(MIN(s.`soil_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_soil_quality`, CAST(MAX(s.`soil_quality_score`) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_soil_quality`, CAST(AVG(s.overall_environment_score) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_overall_score`
			, CAST(MIN(s.overall_environment_score) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_overall_score`, CAST(MAX(s.overall_environment_score) AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_overall_score`, CAST(SUM(s.`heavy_pollution_count`) AS BIGINT) AS `total_heavy_pollution`, CAST(SUM(s.`moderate_pollution_count`) AS BIGINT) AS `total_moderate_pollution`, CAST(SUM(s.`light_pollution_count`) AS BIGINT) AS `total_light_pollution`
			, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN s.environment_grade = '优秀' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `excellent_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN s.environment_grade = '良好' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `good_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN s.environment_grade = '一般' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `fair_count`, CAST(SUM(CASE 
				WHEN s.environment_grade = '较差' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END) AS BIGINT) AS `poor_count`
		FROM daily_result s
		GROUP BY year(s.event_date), month(s.event_date)
	), 
	compared AS (
		SELECT monthly.*, LAG(avg_overall_score) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS previous_score
		FROM monthly
	)
SELECT CAST(s.`year` AS INT) AS `year`, CAST(s.`month` AS INT) AS `month`, CAST(s.`month_date` AS DATE) AS `month_date`, CAST(s.`monitoring_locations` AS BIGINT) AS `monitoring_locations`, CAST(s.`total_data_points` AS BIGINT) AS `total_data_points`
	, CAST(s.`avg_water_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_water_quality`, CAST(s.`min_water_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_water_quality`, CAST(s.`max_water_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_water_quality`, CAST(s.`avg_air_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_air_quality`, CAST(s.`min_air_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_air_quality`
	, CAST(s.`max_air_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_air_quality`, CAST(s.`avg_soil_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_soil_quality`, CAST(s.`min_soil_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_soil_quality`, CAST(s.`max_soil_quality` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_soil_quality`, CAST(s.`avg_overall_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `avg_overall_score`
	, CAST(s.`min_overall_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `min_overall_score`, CAST(s.`max_overall_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `max_overall_score`, CAST(s.`total_heavy_pollution` AS BIGINT) AS `total_heavy_pollution`, CAST(s.`total_moderate_pollution` AS BIGINT) AS `total_moderate_pollution`, CAST(s.`total_light_pollution` AS BIGINT) AS `total_light_pollution`
	, CAST(s.`excellent_count` AS BIGINT) AS `excellent_count`, CAST(s.`good_count` AS BIGINT) AS `good_count`, CAST(s.`fair_count` AS BIGINT) AS `fair_count`, CAST(s.`poor_count` AS BIGINT) AS `poor_count`, CAST((CASE 
		WHEN previous_score IS NULL THEN 'baseline'
		WHEN avg_overall_score > previous_score THEN 'improving'
		WHEN avg_overall_score < previous_score THEN 'declining'
		ELSE 'stable'
	END) AS STRING) AS `trend_direction`
	, CAST((current_timestamp()) AS TIMESTAMP) AS `created_at`
FROM compared s

name: 环境监测 ADS设备性能 · IoT五库
grain: 每设备一条；真实天数、观测数量、在线率、电量与故障统计
description: 2026-09-09 五库等价迁移；口径冻结为已验收环境监测契约。原始CSV通过平台追加接入，历史库与数据保留。
selectSql:
WITH device_statistics AS (
		SELECT CAST(f.device_id AS STRING) AS `device_id`, CAST(d.device_type AS STRING) AS `device_type`, CAST(d.manufacturer AS STRING) AS `manufacturer`, CAST(d.vendor_type AS STRING) AS `vendor_type`, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.event_date) AS BIGINT) AS `active_days`
			, CAST(SUM(f.data_points) AS BIGINT) AS `total_data_points`, CAST((SUM(f.data_points) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.event_date)) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS `avg_daily_data_points`, CAST((SUM(f.online_count) * 1.0 / SUM(f.data_points)) AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `avg_online_rate`, CAST(MIN(f.online_rate) AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `min_online_rate`, CAST(MAX(f.online_rate) AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `max_online_rate`
			, CAST((SUM(f.avg_battery_level * f.data_points) / SUM(f.data_points)) AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) AS `avg_battery_level`, CAST(MIN(f.min_battery_level) AS INT) AS `min_battery_level`, CAST((SUM(f.avg_signal_strength * f.data_points) / SUM(f.data_points)) AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) AS `avg_signal_strength`, CAST(MIN(f.min_signal_strength) AS INT) AS `min_signal_strength`, CAST(SUM(f.fault_count) AS BIGINT) AS `total_fault_count`
			, CAST(SUM(f.offline_count) AS BIGINT) AS `total_offline_count`
		FROM `dwt_iot_db`.`device_status_fact` f
			JOIN `dwt_iot_db`.`dim_device` d ON f.device_key = d.device_key
		GROUP BY f.device_id, d.device_type, d.manufacturer, d.vendor_type
	), 
	scored_devices AS (
		SELECT a.*, CAST(avg_online_rate * 0.6 + (100 - avg_battery_level) / 100 * 0.2 + active_days / 365.0 * 0.2 AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS reliability_score
		FROM device_statistics a
	)
SELECT CAST(s.`device_id` AS STRING) AS `device_id`, CAST(s.`device_type` AS STRING) AS `device_type`, CAST(s.`manufacturer` AS STRING) AS `manufacturer`, CAST(s.`vendor_type` AS STRING) AS `vendor_type`, CAST(s.`active_days` AS BIGINT) AS `active_days`
	, CAST(s.`total_data_points` AS BIGINT) AS `total_data_points`, CAST(s.`avg_daily_data_points` AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS `avg_daily_data_points`, CAST(s.`avg_online_rate` AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `avg_online_rate`, CAST(s.`min_online_rate` AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `min_online_rate`, CAST(s.`max_online_rate` AS DECIMAL(5, 4)) AS `max_online_rate`
	, CAST(s.`avg_battery_level` AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) AS `avg_battery_level`, CAST(s.`min_battery_level` AS INT) AS `min_battery_level`, CAST(s.`avg_signal_strength` AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) AS `avg_signal_strength`, CAST(s.`min_signal_strength` AS INT) AS `min_signal_strength`, CAST(s.`total_fault_count` AS BIGINT) AS `total_fault_count`
	, CAST(s.`total_offline_count` AS BIGINT) AS `total_offline_count`, CAST(s.`reliability_score` AS DECIMAL(4, 3)) AS `reliability_score`, CAST((CASE 
		WHEN reliability_score >= 0.9 THEN '优秀'
		WHEN reliability_score >= 0.8 THEN '良好'
		WHEN reliability_score >= 0.7 THEN '一般'
		ELSE '较差'
	END) AS STRING) AS `performance_grade`, CAST((CASE 
		WHEN avg_battery_level < 20 THEN '需要更换电池'
		WHEN avg_online_rate < 0.8 THEN '需要检查设备连接'
		WHEN total_fault_count > 10 THEN '需要维护检修'
		ELSE '运行正常'
	END) AS STRING) AS `maintenance_suggestion`, CAST((current_timestamp()) AS TIMESTAMP) AS `created_at`
FROM scored_devices s
